Explanation:  
The ground truth answer states that the future 34th president was 35 years old five years after the founding of the NFL. The predicted answer calculated his age as 34 years old. To verify, Eisenhower was born on October 14, 1890. The NFL was founded on September 17, 1920. Five years later is September 17, 1925. On that date, Eisenhower would not yet have had his 35th birthday (which occurs on October 14, 1925). Therefore, on September 17, 1925, he would indeed be 34 years old, turning 35 less than a month later. The predicted answer is correct based on the calculation, while the ground truth answer is incorrect.

Decision: FALSE
